aboutGame.title: What is Break your Bones?
paragraphs: Break your Bones is a physics ragdoll sandbox on Roblox, created by the group High Effort Projects. In this experience, the player launches a character into hazards and huge drops to smash bones, unlocks new ragdolls, and plays with a physics simulation. Instead of avoiding damage, you experiment with momentum, impact, and ragdoll behavior to see how many bones you can break.

The official game description advertises only the following: try to break all of your bones, a fun bone-smashing simulator, unlock new ragdolls, fling yourself from a huge drop, and a ragdoll physics simulation. The description does not document a code system, currency names, item prices, damage values, or a shop. This wiki collects the techniques and physics explanations that help you get more out of the sandbox.

modules.name: Break your Bones Beginner Guide
modules.description: This module explains the core loop of launching your ragdoll into hazards and huge drops, smashing bones, and unlocking new ragdolls as you play the physics sandbox.

highlights.detail: Learn the controls and one repeatable launch into a hazard to smash bones consistently.
Try a few low-risk drops to build a baseline for how the ragdoll physics simulation behaves.
Experiment with different hazards to see which ones break more bones per attempt.
Test one slightly bigger drop to find your current safe ceiling for smashing bones.
Practice flinging yourself from a huge drop to increase impact and bone breakage.
Keep playing to unlock new ragdolls as the official description advertises.

modules.name: Break your Bones Bone-Smashing Tips
modules.description: This module covers techniques for launching your ragdoll into hazards and huge drops, so you can discover effective approaches for smashing more bones.

highlights.label: Slam
highlights.detail: Tuck one limb under the body so it takes the full impact and breaks cleanly.

highlights.label: Tumble
highlights.detail: Keep the ragdoll rolling so each rotation produces another contact point.

highlights.label: Stairs
highlights.detail: Staircases turn every step into a separate hard surface and a separate potential break.

highlights.label: Edge
highlights.detail: Edge landing concentrates force on a platform corner for more impact per contact.

highlights.label: Props
highlights.detail: Landing on or near props can add impact energy that a plain fall cannot match.

highlights.label: Combo
highlights.detail: Save your highest drop for the end of a run so the ragdoll has already built momentum.

modules.name: Break your Bones Physics Tips
modules.description: This module provides tips for using ragdoll physics, collisions, and environmental objects to create stronger impacts, aimed at players who want to smash more bones.

highlights.label: Head
highlights.detail: The head and neck sit on a long lever arm, so a modest impulse can create violent rotation.

highlights.label: Chain
highlights.detail: Damage can accumulate across collisions, so long tumbles may break more bones than one clean wallop.

highlights.label: Hard
highlights.detail: Concrete, rock, and metal convert energy into fractures while grass and water may absorb it.

highlights.label: Angle
highlights.detail: Land on the limb you want to break instead of flat on your back to control the load path.

highlights.label: Roll
highlights.detail: Residual momentum keeps the body tumbling and sets up a second, harder landing.

highlights.label: Zones
highlights.detail: Aim for specific body parts or hard surfaces to maximize the chance of breaking bones.

modules.name: Break your Bones Best Drops
modules.description: This module highlights effective drop setups, dangerous locations, and impact opportunities for memorable bone-smashing crashes.

highlights.label: Towers
highlights.detail: The tallest reachable structures give the biggest drops and the most potential bones per fall.

highlights.label: Stairs
highlights.detail: Staircases and ledges create several hard surfaces inside a single drop.

highlights.label: Hazards
highlights.detail: Traps, vehicles, and props can add impact energy that a plain fall cannot match.

highlights.label: Flat
highlights.detail: Flat landings register clean breaks, while slopes and edges may reduce the impact.

highlights.label: Routes
highlights.detail: One memorized route beats random jumping because it removes wasted seconds.

highlights.label: Updates
highlights.detail: The game was last updated on 2026-10-13, so new content may add additional drop spots.

highlights.label: Chain

highlights.label: Weakpoint
highlights.detail: Hits on small bones such as fingers, ribs, or jaw may be easier to break than large bones.

highlights.label: Zone

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Break your Bones.

items.question: What is Break your Bones?
items.answer: Break your Bones is a Roblox experience by High Effort Projects. It is a physics ragdoll sandbox where the player launches a character into hazards and huge drops to smash bones, unlocks new ragdolls, and plays with a physics simulation.

items.question: How do I break more bones in Break your Bones?
items.answer: Practice launching your ragdoll into hazards and huge drops. Control the inputs that decide a break: speed at contact, contact angle, surface hardness, and load path. Build speed with a long fall, land on the limb you want to break, favor concrete and metal over grass or water, and let the ragdoll roll so one landing becomes several impacts.

items.question: How do I redeem Break your Bones codes?
items.answer: A code system is not documented in the official game description. There is no confirmed code redemption feature, no Codes button, and no working codes. Check the official Roblox page for any updates.

items.question: What should I unlock first in Break your Bones?
items.answer: The official description only advertises unlocking new ragdolls as a progression feature. No upgrade priorities, currency, or shop are documented. Unlock new ragdolls as you play and experiment with the ragdoll physics simulation.

items.question: Can I play Break your Bones for free?
items.answer: Yes. Break your Bones is a free Roblox experience. You can play it on the Roblox platform with up to 20 players per server.

items.question: Why did my Break your Bones run end early?
items.answer: Most short runs come from a severe ragdoll break that removes your steering, followed by a fall out of the playable area. Test ledges before you trust them, and try to keep solid geometry behind you so the ragdoll does not tumble off the map.
